groups.description: The focal registry and its peer Regional Internet Registries — the organizations whose member services, registry accuracy, and RPKI practice set the operating norms this domain is modeled on.

links.title: RIPE NCC — What We Do
links.relevance: The focal RIR's own scope statement — registry, member services, RPKI, DNS, and measurement — the ground truth for every persona in this domain.

links.title: RIPE NCC — List of Services
links.relevance: Enumerates the member and public-interest services the Local Internet Registry Operator persona evaluates and depends on.

links.title: ARIN — Regional Internet Registry
links.relevance: Peer RIR for North America; a comparison point for member experience, fee structure, and registry policy that shapes operator expectations.

groups.description: Standards and authoritative resources behind routing-data trustworthiness — RPKI, ROAs, and BGP origin validation.

links.title: RIPE NCC — RPKI resource management
links.relevance: The primary RPKI/ROA management surface that the Routing Security and Peering Engineer persona uses to authorize route origins.

links.title: MANRS — Mutually Agreed Norms for Routing Security
links.relevance: The industry baseline for routing hygiene (filtering, anti-spoofing, RPKI) that frames the routing engineer's adoption goals and incident response.

links.title: RIPE Database — registry and reverse DNS
links.relevance: The authoritative registry of record whose accuracy underpins both LIR resource management and routing engineers' filtering decisions.

groups.description: Where number-resource and routing policy is debated and set — context for the governance and policy persona.

links.title: RIPE community and policy development
links.relevance: The bottom-up policy process the Internet Governance and Policy Participant persona joins to propose and shape number-resource policy.

links.title: ICANN — global coordination of names and numbers
links.relevance: The top-level coordination body for the number and naming system; sets the global governance context within which RIR policy operates.

groups.description: Public-interest measurement and analytics platforms used well beyond paying members.

links.title: RIPE Atlas — global Internet measurement
links.relevance: The active-measurement network the Internet Measurement Researcher and Public Analyst persona queries for reachability and routing observations.

links.title: RIPEstat — Internet number resource analytics
links.relevance: The open data and visualization portal researchers and analysts use to inspect prefixes, ASNs, RPKI status, and routing history.
